title: Dodging a Galactic Blast
front_description: "Hang on, son!" Jango Fett tells his co-pilot Boba. "We'll move into the asteroid field. And we'll have a couple of surprises for him." Not only must Obi-Wan Kenobi navigate his way through these treacherous space rocks, he must also avoid being pulverized by sonic charges aimed in his direction by Jango."There he is!" shouts Boba, spotting Kenobi's ship right behind them. Jango shrugs, surprised that Obi-Wan just can't "take a hint."
back_description: A model shot of Slave I, Jango Fett's distinctive space ship.
